name: uniBTC
rootCause: Bedrock's uniBTC protocol was exploited on Ethereum on 26 September 2024, allowing an attacker to mint uniBTC at an improper 1:1 ratio with ETH and drain about $1.7M from DEX liquidity pools. The vulnerability stemmed from a faulty mint function, and was enabled by insider access and malware. A vulnerable mint function in the uniBTC contract failed to account for the real price difference between ETH and BTC, enabling minting at an incorrect 1:1 ratio. Insider access via malware enabled early discovery and exploitation.
